errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue line ('Брой държави в света') drops to 9 in 2008. According to the chart, the blue line has a value of 14 in 2008. The value 9 in 2008 belongs to the orange line ('Брой държави в Европа').
The description states that the value for the blue line in 2018 is 29. The chart clearly shows the value for that point is 40. The value 29 corresponds to a point around the year 2016.
The description claims the blue line reaches 57 in 2023. However, the data series for the blue line ends at the value 57 around the year 2020, not 2023.
The description claims the orange line drops to 6 in 2008. The chart shows that in 2008, the value for the orange line is 9. It drops to 6 later, around the year 2010.
The description claims the orange line reaches 33 in 2023. The chart shows this data series ends at the value 33 around the year 2020, not 2023.
